changelog: Fixed ROE Checker revenue coverage so adjacent brackets sharing only an endpoint are conflicts, with consistent LMM, UMM, CORP, ENT, Hybrid, and revenue-based region checks.
Fixed Sales Rep searches in ROE Checker, Bulk Transfer, and Sales Reps so blank Sales Roles display --- instead of a manager's name.
Added support for NSCORP /next/customer/ record links in Records Search, Merge Assistant, Static Group, Bulk Transfer, ROE Checker, and SuiteWorld Duplicate Finder.
Added a live record counter during Bulk Transfer, showing the current record and how many have been processed.
Removed obsolete internal code and superseded styles while preserving the existing UI and workflows.
